subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 8: plurals with -s (books, dogs, cats) and the function of -s

show.line: One book. Two books! Add s when there is more than one.

rounds.praise: Yes! Dogs. More than one dog.

rounds.prompt: One book, two... what? Say it.
One or more than one? Sort the pictures.

hints: Count them. More than one? Add s.
Listen to the end. Cat, cats.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Two cats. Let me say it.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two cats. We add s.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. One cat, two cats!

parent_line: Knows that we add s to show more than one, like books and dogs.
